run_singlepoint_calculations: run single point energy and force calculations on atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_energy_for_structures: calculate energy for a subset of molecular structures split across parallel array jobs
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a results directory
normalize_properties_by_natoms: normalize calculated properties by number of atoms or a custom atoms.info key
save_target_properties: save target properties from atoms.info alongside calculated energy and force results
